description: Small Ralph self-iteration for the current branch. The previous PRD belonged to `ralph/self-iteration-20260519-055841` and all stories were passing, so it was archived under `scripts/ralph/archive/self-iteration-20260519-064552/`. No PR CI auto-fix context was present. GitHub CI health at kickoff: latest main CI run 26064673112 was still in progress, previous PR #23 CI was green, and previous main CI after PR #22 was green. Local kickoff checks passed for the current Playwright contract test and US-444 list discovery. The known fresh-CI embed risk is covered by `cmd/server/embed_ci_bdd_test.go` and the tracked `cmd/server/web/embed-placeholder.txt`; the US-453 streamless binary response risk has coverage in `ComplianceReportsPage.test.tsx`. The dogfood issues DOG-001 through DOG-005 have current code/tests. This PRD focuses on remaining US-444 full-stack smoke gates that still treat wired OSv2 service regressions as skips.

userStories.name: Make US-444 function publish and replay gates reject unwired Functions APIs
userStories.description: Strengthen the function publish and replay Playwright probes so a reachable full-stack backend must expose the Functions create, version-list, execute, replay, and delete endpoints instead of passing through skip paths.
bdd_acceptance: Given the US-444 suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/18-fn-publish.spec.ts` creates a Function, Then 404, 503, and other non-OK create responses fail the test instead of calling `test.skip`.
Given function creation succeeds, When the publish spec lists versions and deletes the Function, Then both endpoints are asserted successful and the version list contains `1.0.0`.

Given `us444/19-fn-replay.spec.ts` publishes a deterministic Function, When it executes and replays the Function, Then execute and replay must return successful statuses and replay output must not contain `WEAVE_FUNCTION_NONDETERMINISTIC`.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the function publish and replay specs are parsed, Then both scenarios remain discoverable and contain no `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards.
quality_gates: `npm --prefix web exec playwright test -- --list us444/18-fn-publish.spec.ts us444/19-fn-replay.spec.ts`
`rg -n "test\\.(skip|fixme)\\(" web/e2e/us444/18-fn-publish.spec.ts web/e2e/us444/19-fn-replay.spec.ts` must return no matches

userStories.name: Make US-444 saga gates reject unwired saga APIs
userStories.description: Strengthen the saga Playwright smoke probe so the full-stack backend must expose applySaga and saga DLQ endpoints rather than skipping when the route or store is unavailable.
bdd_acceptance: Given the US-444 suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/05-saga.spec.ts` posts an empty saga, Then a missing route fails the test instead of being skipped.
Given the empty saga request is invalid, When the response is decoded, Then it must be a structured 4xx with a non-empty `errorCode` or `errorName`.
Given the saga DLQ list endpoint is requested, When the full-stack backend is reachable, Then the endpoint must return a successful structured response rather than 404 or 503.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the saga spec is parsed, Then its scenarios remain discoverable and contain no `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards.

userStories.name: Make US-444 masking gates reject unwired admin mask APIs
userStories.description: Strengthen the column-mask and cell-mask Playwright probes so the full-stack backend must expose the admin masking CRUD surfaces rather than accepting 404 store-unwired skips.
bdd_acceptance: Given the US-444 suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/16-mask.spec.ts` requests column-mask list and invalid create, Then 404 responses fail and successful/structured validation responses are asserted.

Given the US-444 suite runs against a reachable full-stack backend, When `us444/17-cell-mask.spec.ts` requests cell-mask list and invalid create, Then 404 responses fail and successful/structured validation responses are asserted.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the mask specs are parsed, Then their scenarios remain discoverable and contain no `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards.
quality_gates: `npm --prefix web exec playwright test -- --list us444/16-mask.spec.ts us444/17-cell-mask.spec.ts`
`rg -n "test\\.(skip|fixme)\\(" web/e2e/us444/16-mask.spec.ts web/e2e/us444/17-cell-mask.spec.ts` must return no matches
